neural_metrics.compute_scores: ID sets per true-present interval; preserves source FP==0 or FN==0 shortcut returning precision=recall=1 when TP>0. Empty true intervals omitted.
neural_metrics.compute_scores_scikit: Predicted-present intervals; weighted binary F1 across active ID union; no true-negative IDs in union. Empty predicted intervals omitted.
neural_metrics.interface: Both source formulas reported separately over each full50ms interface window, not a selected source/paper reward. 5ms/native10ms, token truncation and definitive Figure6 branch unqualified.

teacher_forced_branch.meaning: Per-position token multiclass F1 under teacher forcing, distinct from both interval-ID helpers and held-out recursive rollout; dense raster cannot recover truncated token order. Not implemented as the paper score.

neural_metrics.observed_call: visualize.py:1191-1192 invokes compute_scores, but no authenticated Figure6 branch/run provenance was established.

token_boundary.operation: round each rate value then repeat neuron ID that many times, ordered by bin then neuron; retain last block_size-2 IDs, add SOS/EOS/PAD; dt branch has independent truncation
token_boundary.unqualified: No new5ms biological event transform or equivalence to full untruncated dense raster inferred.
token_boundary.units: No multiplication by dt in rate-to-repeat operation. Upstream count/rate/Hertz units are unresolved; dt token means offset from window start, not inter-event delay.

clock_boundary.native: Current neural interval ends at requested interval; frame request adds one current-window before callback. Exact source clock and position convention need qualification before causal claims.
clock_boundary.interface: Prospective case projection uses explicitly frozen clock and contemporary visual windows; not asserted to match native alignment.

retained_static_signal.meaning: Unchanged NotImplementedError when no intervals passed; original source preserved, no universal supported-runtime claim.

normalization.behavior: Supplied speed/phi/th passed through then sliced/cast/padded/tokenized; no physical-unit normalization or circular-gaze transform in this path.
